title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to dataFor more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.Why You’re HereYou’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.Com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.You’re here to:- Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.- Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.- Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.What You’ll Deliver- Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.- AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.- Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.To, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify).- Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.- Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.Quantitative- New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)- Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)Qualitative- Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing- Speed and creativity of campaign execution- Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content- Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goalsWho You Are- Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.- Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.- AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.- Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.- Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.Requirements- 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products- Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills- Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.- (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer toolsTech You’ll work with- HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics- Figma, Notion, Google Workspace- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideationHow We WorkWe move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.As a new Zytan, you will:Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re). Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;

Avaliar novastecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
Participar dadefinição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
Documentar diagramas,topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos. Segurança, Governança e Compliance Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;

Apoiar o planejamentoe execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede. description: About You This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly. You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments. Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments. Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts. Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage. Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices. Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends. Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines. Solid reliability engineering experience, including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety. Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling. Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation. Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents. Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform, including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation. Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services, ensuring high availability and operational resilience. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation. Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments. Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability. Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews. Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements. Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation. Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures. Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders. Qualifications 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments. Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts. IaC background with Terraform, including environment separation and state management at scale. Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Analista De Devops Sr
description: A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice. O DESAFIO: Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados. Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da\ "cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes. Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real. Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP), garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados. Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual. Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service, priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven. AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos. Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção. Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA: Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA. DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker, Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem. Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas. VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER: Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI). O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica

title: Back-End Developer Golang Sr
description:
Descrição da vaga

Enquanto desenvolvedor sênior, será esperado de você uma capacidade técnica e analítica profunda sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto.

você será uma referencia técnica no time, e deverá exercer certa influencia de liderança. Deverá ser demandado, na maior parte do tempo, em caráter de auxiliador de desenvolvedores mais júniores e, por isso, o comprometimento com a inovação e aquisição de conhecimento dentro do universo Android se faz

essencial para o seu nível de carreira.

Responsabilidades e atribuições



  • Atuar com profunda capacidade técnica e analítica sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto, garantindo evolução contínua das soluções;
  • Ser referência técnica dentro do time, exercendo influência de liderança e apoiando desenvolvedores mais júniores;
  • Contribuir diretamente para inovação e aquisição de conhecimento no ecossistema Android e demais tecnologias envolvidas;
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços resilientes, escaláveis e tolerantes a falhas;
  • Atuar na otimização de latência, throughput e desempenho de sistemas de alta volumetria;
  • Implementar estratégias avançadas de caching, incluindo Redis distribuído;
  • Aplicar rate limiting, circuit breaker e mecanismos de backpressure;
  • Realizar profiling e tuning de aplicações para máxima eficiência;
  • Trabalhar em modelagem de banco de dados orientada à performance e escalabilidade;
  • Atuar com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, conforme as demandas do projeto;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microsserviços em produção, garantindo consistência e disponibilidade;
  • Implementar práticas de observabilidade, monitoramento e tracing distribuído;
  • Atuar com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).




Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência avançada com Golang;
  • Profundo entendimento de concorrência com goroutines, channels e context;
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento no design de serviços resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta volumetria (milhares ou milhões de requisições);
  • Conhecimento emotimização de latência e throughput;
  • Experiência comestratégias de caching, especialmente Redis distribuído;
  • Domínio de técnicas como rate limiting, circuit breaker e backpressure;
  • Habilidade em profiling e tuning de aplicações;
  • Experiência combancos relacionais (PostgreSQL/MySQL);
  • Experiência combancos não relacionais (MongoDB ou similares);
  • Prática com microsserviços em produção e fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos (consistência, tolerância a falhas, observabilidade);
  • Experiência commonitoramento, logging e tracing distribuído;
  • Conhecimento emDocker e Kubernetes;
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.


You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.


You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

description:
Você é apaixonado(a) por transformar o mercado de saúde suplementar através da excelência em gestão de produtos e foco no cliente? Se você tem experiência sólida no setor, domínio regulatório (ANS) e paixão por resultados, queremos você no nosso time!

Suas Responsabilidades e Desafios

Você será o(a) guardião(ã) do nosso P&L e da experiência do cliente. Suas principais atividades incluirão:

Gestão de Negócios e Rentabilidade:
  • Gerenciar o P&L do cluster de clientes , garantindo rentabilidade, competitividade e sustentabilidade.
  • Atualizar e gerir a Tabela de Preços , alinhando ajustes à estratégia comercial e ao posicionamento competitivo.
  • Monitorar indicadores, reportar resultados e apresentar análises de performance para a alta gestão.
Gestão de Clientes e Produtos:
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar a carteira de clientes , assegurando uma jornada consistente, satisfação e retenção.
  • Antecipar necessidades e comportamentos dos clientes, propondo ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Desenvolver soluções e ajustes de produtos que agreguem valor, aumentem a fidelização e fortaleçam a proposta de valor.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre clientes e áreas internas, garantindo comunicação clara e alinhamento estratégico.
Regulatório e Compliance (ANS):
  • Conduzir procedimentos junto à ANS para registro, manutenção, atualização e adequação de produtos.
  • Garantir o compliance contínuo dos planos de saúde, assegurando atendimento às normas regulatórias e documentação atualizada.
Liderança e Processos:
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos de produtos , garantindo escopo, prazo, qualidade e governança.
  • Mapear processos, identificar riscos, propor melhorias e implementar práticas eficientes de gestão.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo colaboração, alinhamento e decisões ágeis.
O que esperamos de você (Requisitos Técnicos)
  • Experiência sólida em Gestão de Produtos no setor de Saúde Suplementar (operadoras, administradoras de benefícios ou correlatos).
  • Conhecimento comprovado em processos e normativas da ANS , incluindo registro, manutenção e alteração de produtos.
  • Vivência com gestão de portfólio , tabelas comerciais, estruturação de produtos e análise de mercado.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado e uso de ferramentas de gestão.
  • Capacidade analítica aplicada à gestão de indicadores e tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes corporativos e gestão de carteiras (Customer Success ).
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Scrum, Lean, Kanban).
Competências Comportamentais
  • Visão Estratégica e Foco no Cliente
  • Comunicação clara, Influência e Negociação
  • Capacidade Analítica e Pensamento Crítico
  • Proatividade, Autonomia e Senso de Dono
  • Colaboração, Gestão de Conflitos e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Organização, Planejamento e Orientação para Resultados .
Formação
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão em Saúde, Economia, Marketing ou áreas afins.

title: Agente de Saneamento - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres
description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Main responsibilities
  • Realizar escavações com a finalidade de localizar a rede de água para executar reparos e novas ligações;
  • Realizar serviços hidráulicos relacionados a vazamentos de água em adutoras, rede, ramal, registro e cavalete;
  • Realizar instalação e substituição de hidrômetros, assim com a padronização de cavalete e ramal;
  • Executar a extensão de rede e a interligação em rede existente, oferecendo serviço de abastecimento de água;
  • Realizar manobras na rede de distribuição de água existente, instalar registro de manobra e descarga da rede;
  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;
  • Realizar demais atividades relacionadas a serviços de instalação/reparo e operação de água.
Requirements and skills
  • Interesse de atuar na área de Saneamento, levando diariamente dignidade nas porta das pessoas;
  • Será um diferencial ter CNH ativa (categoria B ou acima);
  • Perfil dinâmico, com bom relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.
Additional information
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;

description:
Join to apply for the Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica role at e.Quality Soluções e Engenharia LTDA

O Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica é o líder técnico e gestor das operações de engenharia clínica em sua unidade de atuação, assegurando a gestão segura, eficaz e economicamente responsável do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

  • Gestão Operacional e Conformidade: Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados. Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO). Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados. Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos: Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas. Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas. Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica. Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico. Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica. Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
  • Gestão de Ativos e Recursos: Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do
  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
    • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
    • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
    • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
    • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
    • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
    • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
    • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
  • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
  • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
  • Influencer onboarding flows
  • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
  • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
  • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
  • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel. Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
  • You own the full lifecycle:
  • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
  • First‑session experience and activation
  • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
  • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
  • Conversion to paid
  • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
  • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives. Experimentation & Growth Velocity
  • You will:
  • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
  • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
  • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
  • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
  • Scale winners aggressively
  • K‑Factor Optimization
Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection. Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
  • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
  • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
  • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
  • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
  • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
  • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs. Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
  • You will:
  • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
  • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
  • Revenue performance
  • Funnel metrics
  • Experiment results
  • Key risks and opportunities
  • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
The GM should never be surprised by the numbers Success in This Role Means
  • You are directly accountable for:
  • Paid conversion rate
  • ARPU / LTV
  • D7 / D30 retention
  • Revenue by acquisition source
  • LTV / CAC and payback period
  • Experiment velocity
What You Bring to the Team
  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.
Why Join Mode Mobile
  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.
We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule
What We Are Offering
  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager – Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines. The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas. The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília. Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We’re excited to meet people who are energized by complex, ambiguous problems. We look for owners and problem-solvers who are eager to dive into the details of their craft, and are motivated by building products and experiences that meaningfully expand access to ownership.

As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team-matching phase, ensuring that by the final interview, you are aligned with a specific team that matches your strengths and career goals.

High impact domains you might join include:
  • Fund Operations: Building the core engine that powers our vision of an operating system for private capital, simplifying complex accounting workflows.
  • Investor Reporting: Developing features that enable investment firms and audit partners to share accurate, timely performance data.
  • Risk & Compliance: Scaling the infrastructure that ensures security and transparency across billions of dollars in assets.
The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will lead technically complex projects and serve as a multiplier for your team. You’ll work to:

  • Drive Implementation: Lead the execution of complex technical projects, driving them from concept to production while maintaining high standards for performance and reliability.
  • Simplify Systems: Dig deep into our architecture to identify opportunities to simplify code and infrastructure, prioritizing changes that have a measurable business impact.
  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Use the best AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate your workflow, improve code quality, and spend more of your time solving the high-level logic and unconventional problems
  • Foster Growth: Act as a mentor and coach, raising the technical bar for your peers through diligent PR reviews and architectural guidance.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with product and design to ensure we are building the right solution for the user, not just following a specification.
About You
  • The Tech Stack: You have experience with (or a desire to learn) our core technologies: Python, Django, React, Postgres, and Kafka. We also utilize Java, gRPC, and AWS.
  • Execution: You can break down complex user stories into actionable tasks and execute them with minimal guidance.
  • Strategic Mindset: You understand the "why" behind your code and can articulate technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Experience: We recommend 8+ years of professional software engineering experience for this level.
Disclosures
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Reforços e Melhorias de Pequeno Porte da Transmissão - CAPEX
description:
A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Missão do cargo:

Será responsável pela gestão de portfólio da carteira de obras de reforços e melhorias de pequeno porte da AXIA - Sudeste.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  • Apoio na abertura e estruturação de projetos, organizando informações técnicas e financeiras, assegurando alinhamento entre escopo, cronograma e orçamento.
  • Gestão de CAPEX, incluindo planejamento, acompanhamento físico-financeiro e análise de desvios.
  • Acompanhar e gerir os indicadores e metas financeiras das gerências da Operação da AXIA Sudeste.
  • Identificar, analisar e promover transferências de recursos entre projetos, visando otimização do orçamento e atendimento às prioridades estratégicas.

  • Apoiar na gestão técnica contratual dos empreendimentos de transmissão, envolvendo as consolidações de medições mensais de serviços, análises de pleitos e aditivos até o encerramento contratual.
  • Apoiar no controles físicos-financeiros de projetos de implantação, reforço ou modernização de:
    • Subestações de energia elétrica;
    • Linhas de Transmissão.
  • Interagir com áreas internas, promovendo integração entre informações técnicas, operacionais e financeiras.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, painéis de acompanhamento e apresentações para apoio à gerência em reuniões com Alta Governança.

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia elétrica, civil, mecânico ou de produção;

    • Abertura, estruturação e acompanhamento de EAP;
    • Gestão e acompanhamento de CAPEX;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre empreendimentos de transmissão de energia (subestações e linhas de transmissão);
  • Conhecimento dos processos de gestão contratual, desde as fases que antecedem, até o encerramento;
  • Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico - MCPSE da ANEEL;
  • Conhecimento dos processos corporativos de planejamento e orçamento;
  • Conhecimento prático dos pacotes SAP de gestão de projetos, controle orçamentário, e gestão financeira;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio à gestão, incluindo:
    • Excel em nível avançado;
    • Disponibilidade para residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ , São Paulo/SP ou Brasília/DF.
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos ou no Setor Elétrico é um forte diferencial;

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. description:
Overview

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você! Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade.
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações.
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas.
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil.
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Aptidão para vendas.
  • Amplo círculo social (network/rede de relacionamento).
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais.
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor.
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho.
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais.
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais.
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

Overview

We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

Key Responsibilities

As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
  • Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
  • Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
  • Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
  • Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
  • Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
  • Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
  • Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
  • You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery’s utilities.
  • You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
  • You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
  • You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
  • You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
  • You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
  • You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.
